rule: Component values from carStats may seed relative starting specs but must not be described as exact real-world measured engineering values.
Starting specs are fitted-on-car seeds only; they do not create inventory or imply spare stock.
Known facility fields seed starting facilities; absent concepts use derived_gameplay_baseline and remain non-source-locked.
Manufacturing capacity is an index for gameplay initialization; actual jobs, queues and production are Save World state.
Upgrade source_lock_status only after row-level external source confirms the historical claim.
v1.2.5 should be integrated only after v1.2.3 canonical promotion and v1.2.4 technical source candidate validation.
